mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the returns and cup was most worthwhile: the descriptions showed how the front gap became a place for the cup.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate side-rail fittings felt repetitive in the text interface, though each produced a clear physical change.

surprise.text: The lane rail formed a long inner lane rather than another outer edge.

arbitrary.text: None of the fittings felt arbitrary; each followed the current goal and visibly changed the table.

continue.text: I would continue to see the launcher and paddles added, though the repeated text commands were less engaging than the emerging construction.
